meaning:
A woman living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.4.17; married to Heber (H2268H)
§ Jael = "mountain goat"
the wife of Heber the Kenite who killed the general Sisera as he slept by driving a peg through his temples into the ground

elsewhere.note: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of…
